Ultrawide-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Wide-angle lens listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple's Ultra Wide lens — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Ultrawide phrasing

US pages use "Ultrawide", "Ultra Wide", "Ultra Wide lens", "0.5x", "0.5×", "Wide field of view", or "Super wide." Apple's Simplified Chinese Camera vocabulary often uses 超广角 for the general ultrawide feature, 超广角镜头 for lens-picker marketing, and 超广角相机 when your English listing brands Ultrawide Camera as a mode name. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing lens capabilities your app does not support.

0.5× badge vs wide framing outcome

Ultrawide marketing often shows the 0.5× lens badge alongside wide landscape or group demos. Chinese buyers expect concise labels on gallery frames: 0.5倍超广角, 0.5×超广角, or 超广角镜头 when the lens picker is the hero — not English "0.5x" pasted through machine translation without context.

Subject types per frame

Screenshot overlays differ by subject — mountain horizons, city skylines, group photos in restaurants, architecture facades, narrow interior rooms. Chinese buyers expect per-frame captions: 风景超广角 for landscape wide shots, 合影超广角 for group framing, 建筑超广角 for architecture demos — not one generic "强大相机" string on every frame.

Ultrawide vs Macro on the same sensor

The ultra-wide sensor serves both wide FoV framing and Macro close-ups on supported iPhones. When your English listing markets both, zh-Hans overlays must scope each frame accurately — 超广角 for wide landscape and group shots, 微距 for minimum-focus-distance close-ups — distinct buyer promises with different screenshot vocabulary on the same product page.

Do not conflate with Camera Control, Cinematic Mode, or Action Mode

Ultrawide Camera selects the 0.5× lens for wide field of view. Camera Control assigns hardware button gestures on iPhone 16 — different buyer promise. Cinematic Mode adds shallow-depth cinematic look to video. Action Mode stabilizes handheld walking-running video. If your app supports multiple Camera surfaces, scope each screenshot frame accurately.

Does shipping Ultrawide Camera or 0.5× Ultra Wide auto-translate my China listing?

No. Ultra-wide lens selection, 0.5× field-of-view capture, and in-app wide-framing flows control device behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) copy for App Store Connect listing fields you specify: title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines — rewritten from your English Ultrawide marketing originals.

Can AppLocale implement Ultra Wide lens switching or multi-camera capture?

No. We deliver listing metadata copy only. Ultrawide capture engineering, 0.5× lens wiring, and wide-angle sample photo design are outside AppLocale scope.

How is this different from Camera Control hardware button UX?

Ultrawide copy markets 0.5× wide field-of-view framing — 超广角, 超广角镜头, 0.5×. Camera Control copy markets iPhone 16 dedicated capture hardware gestures — 相机控制, 轻按对焦, 半按拍照, 滑动变焦. A gallery frame showing the lens picker at 0.5× is ultrawide marketing; a frame showing light-press focus on the Camera Control button is hardware UX marketing — different screenshot vocabulary.

How is this different from Macro close-up photography?

Ultrawide copy markets wide landscape, group, and architecture framing at 0.5× — 超广角. Macro copy markets extreme close-up stills at minimum focus distance — 微距, 微距近拍. Both may use the ultra-wide sensor on supported iPhones, but the buyer promise and screenshot subjects differ: skyline horizons vs flower petal detail.

How is this different from Photographic Styles, Cinematic Mode, Action Mode, Portrait Mode, Night Mode, or Photonic Engine?

Ultrawide copy markets 0.5× lens field of view — 超广角. Photographic Styles copy markets still-photo tone presets — 摄影风格. Cinematic Mode copy markets shallow-depth cinematic video — 浅景深电影效果视频.
